description: Header file defining classes for generating PUCCH orthogonal sequences for 3GPP LTE/NR communications, including sequence generation for formats 1 and 4.

classes.name: pucch_orthogonal_sequence_format1
classes.description: Generates and provides access to orthogonal sequences for PUCCH Format 1.

classes.name: pucch_orthogonal_sequence_format4
classes.description: Generates and provides access to orthogonal sequences for PUCCH Format 4.

methods.name: pucch_orthogonal_sequence_format1()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes sequences based on predefined coefficients.

methods.name: get_sequence_value
methods.description: Returns a specific value from the orthogonal sequence based on input indices.

methods.name: get_sequence_conj
methods.description: Returns the conjugated sequence for a given sequence index.

methods.name: pucch_orthogonal_sequence_format4::get_sequence
methods.description: Returns the entire orthogonal sequence for Format 4 based on sequence length and index.
